issues.failure_explanation: Replacing the infinite trapezoidal sum by its integral supplies no upper error bound. Moreover, the theorem places no restriction on h, and its conclusion is false for large h. Write B=b-a and fix N=2. issues.failure_explanation: The exponential of the stated tridiagonal matrix is generally dense, so its LR factors do not have the prescribed bandwidth.
